# Federal News Network

> > Federal News Network provides breaking news, analysis, and podcasts covering federal government operations, defense policy, workforce management, and digital transformation.

Federal News Network is a comprehensive news and media platform serving federal employees, government executives, and defense industry professionals. The site combines breaking news coverage with in-depth podcast series addressing federal workforce issues, defense spending, IT modernization, and government management trends.

## Key Topics

- Federal Agencies
- Federal Workforce
- Defense Policy
- Government Modernization
- AI Implementation
- Digital Transformation
- Federal Employees
- Cybersecurity
- Defense Industry
- Department of Defense
- OPM
- Financial Planning
- GSA
- Federal Government News

## Podcasts & Shows

- [The Business of Government Hour](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/shows/business-of-government-hour-podcast): Podcast series hosted by Michael J. Keegan featuring government executives and thought leaders.
- [On DoD with Jared Serbu](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/shows/on-dod-with-jared-serbu-podcast): Weekly podcast with Deputy Editor Jared Serbu interviewing Department of Defense managers.
- [Innovation in Government](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/shows/innovation-in-government-podcast): Podcast covering innovation, AI, and digital transformation in federal agencies.
- [Modern Government](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/shows/modern-government): Podcast on federal modernization, digital transformation, and government operations.
- [SDFM: The Business of Defense](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/shows/the-business-of-defense): Podcast on defense industry, federal contracting, and military business leadership.
- [Your Federal Life](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/shows/your-federal-life-podcast): Podcast providing career management and financial planning guidance for federal employees.
- [Eye on Washington with Jessica Klement](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/shows/eye-on-washington): Podcast by Jessica Klement covering federal policy, pay, benefits, and workforce issues.
- [All Podcasts](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/shows): Central hub listing all Federal News Network podcast shows and episodes.

## Breaking News & Analysis

- [DoD plans to spend entire $152 billion from reconciliation bill in one year](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/defense-main/2026/02/dod-plans-to-spend-entire-152-billion-from-reconciliation-bill-in-one-year): Breaking news on Department of Defense spending plans for fiscal 2026.
- [Agencies plan to decommission hundreds of .gov websites following GSA review](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/it-modernization/2025/07/agencies-plan-to-decommission-hundreds-of-gov-websites-following-gsa-review): News article on GSA-directed federal website decommissioning and IT modernization efforts.
- [OPM's Kupor defends Schedule Policy/Career, as finalization nears](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/workforce/2026/03/opms-kupor-defends-schedule-policy-career-as-finalization-nears): News article on OPM director's defense of Schedule Policy/Career and performance management reforms.
- [A standout year for the TSP is giving investors plenty to build on for 2026](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/pay-benefits/2026/02/a-standout-year-for-the-tsp-is-giving-investors-plenty-to-build-on-for-2026): Article on TSP investment performance and federal employee retirement planning strategies.
